description: JavaScript plugin for tooltips (Tipsy) that provides customizable tooltip behavior using jQuery, including positioning, fading, and content options.

methods.name: tipsy
methods.description: Main function to initialize tooltip behavior on selected elements, handling hover events to show/hide tips.

methods.name: elementOptions
methods.description: Retrieves element-specific options, possibly using metadata.

methods.name: autoNS
methods.description: Determines vertical gravity ('n' or 's') based on element position relative to viewport center.

methods.name: autoWE
methods.description: Determines horizontal gravity ('w' or 'e') based on element position relative to viewport center.
